deviations.from: subtype DIAGRAM on slots ITEM-0455-3.8-002-DIAGRAM and ITEM-0455-3.8-007-DIAGRAM
deviations.to: subtype SYNTH carrying the slots' assessment objectives (AO2, AO3), command word (Discuss), tariff (8) and Bloom level (Apply), with no diagram
deviations.why: the v0.2.0 learning-items schema has no DIAGRAM subtype, and the 3.8 syllabus states that diagrams are not required for market structure. Review on 13 October 2026 replaced the earlier verbal diagram walk-throughs (axes, curves, a 'new equilibrium') with Discuss items that link the change - new sellers entering a market of many small sellers; a single seller behind a barrier raising its price - to its consequences for buyers and sellers in words, so the marking guidance names the SYNTH parts (the link, the consequence) and no longer the DIAGRAM parts. The work order still assigns DIAGRAM to these two slots; that is a plan problem reported to the lead. The prompts avoid the words chart and graph because this subject declares no chart model and C-35 and C-41 would otherwise demand a rendered depiction.
